verification_support_role: Adds independent saved numerical decisions, role/dtype/timer partitions and least-squares timing audit, without replacing frozen numerical modules.

public_replay_scope.status: prospective complete public numerical replay of finite dense scaling benchmark
public_replay_scope.comparison: All24 decimal and binary64 K matrices, all166 qualification decisions and six discrete-oracle pairs reproduce exactly. Timing fits and hypotheses are recalculated as fresh observations; timing-hypothesis identity is not a numerical replay gate.
public_replay_scope.shape_log_scope: Original producer logs role, elapsed time and output dtype, but not array shape despite the design requesting it. Fixed source specifies dense298 propagation. No independent per-call shape measurement is claimed.
public_replay_scope.motivation: Numerical decisions pass. Recurring extended dense solves now dominate; independently reproduce accuracy before selecting an optimized arithmetic kernel. Synthetic marginal rates do not qualify native CO cost or conditioning.
public_replay_scope.stopping_rule: Run once from fresh public bytes. Preserve original exits. Numerical mismatch stops further submissions. No additional timing repeats or interval counts, no numerical-source replacement or automatic CO invocation.
